Frequently Asked Questions
Why was Hitachi Vantara named a Leader in the GigaOm Radar for AI-optimized storage?
Hitachi Vantara was recognized as a Leader in the GigaOm Radar for High-Performance Storage Optimized for AI Workloads due to its robust, scalable infrastructure and deep commitment to solving enterprise AI challenges. The GigaOm report highlights Hitachi’s ability to deliver high throughput, low latency, and strong data protection. All of which are critical for AI and machine learning success.
With proven performance at scale, integrated file systems, and AI-ready platforms like Hitachi Content Software for File and the iQ M Series, Hitachi stands out as a trusted provider of future-proof AI infrastructure for mission-critical enterprise applications.
What is Hitachi iQ and how does it support enterprise-scale AI transformation?
Hitachi iQ is a comprehensive AI solutions stack that combines high-performance infrastructure with deep industry expertise to help businesses accelerate digital transformation. It unifies compute, storage, and data orchestration to deliver a seamless, scalable platform for AI, ML, and analytics workloads, no matter where data resides.
With capabilities that span from early-stage AI discovery to advanced AI operations management, Hitachi iQ helps bridge the skills gap, automate IT, and ensure relevant, compliant data is always available for AI applications. It’s an ideal foundation for businesses seeking to adopt GenAI and drive measurable outcomes from their data.
What makes the Hitachi iQ M Series ideal for GenAI infrastructure?
The Hitachi iQ M Series is a modular, adaptable infrastructure solution purpose-built for GenAI workloads. It integrates accelerated compute (including NVIDIA GPUs), high-speed networking, and scalable enterprise or high-performance storage, delivering the flexibility and power required for training, tuning, and deploying large language models (LLMs), RAG frameworks, and inferencing tasks.
Certified for NVIDIA DGX BasePOD™, the M Series combines performance, reliability, and cost efficiency in a pre-integrated, validated platform that allows organizations to run cutting-edge GenAI applications at scale with confidence.
How does Hitachi Vantara help businesses accelerate and manage AI operations?
Hitachi Vantara simplifies AI infrastructure and operations through AIOps-powered management, advanced analytics, and integrated automation. These capabilities reduce manual workload, accelerate AI pipeline efficiency, and improve visibility across hybrid environments.
Hitachi also offers a structured AI Discovery Service, guiding customers through every step of their AI journey, from identifying opportunities to implementing enterprise-grade solutions. This holistic approach empowers businesses to innovate rapidly, maximize data value, and maintain operational agility without adding complexity.
What industries benefit most from Hitachi iQ’s AI solution stack?
Hitachi iQ is designed with industry-specific AI use cases in mind, making it especially valuable for sectors like healthcare, manufacturing, energy, and finance. For example, the Isle of Wight NHS Trust leveraged Hitachi iQ to power medical imaging advancements and prepare for the next generation of digital healthcare innovation.
With 100+ years of expertise spanning IT and operational technology (OT), Hitachi is uniquely positioned to help organizations solve complex problems using AI, turning data into actionable insights and enabling outcomes that are meaningful, measurable, and sustainable.
